description.en: Creates an event camera object with the given name and returns its handle. No shipped script calls it; the events load animated cameras with CMND_LOAD_CAMERA or move the active camera instead.
Name of the new camera object.

Handle of the new camera.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A new camera placed by script (not found in script_clean/; invented)
